messages:
Priya: FYI - MediCore is requesting a 30-day POC that MUST run in their VPC (no public egress), ship audit logs to their Splunk HEC, and use their CMK for at-rest encryption. They also want the audit artifacts (sanitized sample logs, log schema, retention confirmation) before go-live.

Sam: Quick clarifying Q: do they want a Private deployment or a Dedicated pool inside their VPC? If they want complete no-egress, Private deployment packaging is the safer route. Dedicated in-VPC is possible but needs infra capacity allocation.

Priya: They said "no public egress for data plane" and prefer BYOK for log encryption. They also asked who can see full prompt text during the POC 1 we should default to redaction unless customer signs off.

Rohit: Security checklist for this POC: completed security questionnaire, CMK ARN + cross-account grant, Splunk HEC endpoint + allowlist, sample sanitized payloads, admin audit logs covering API key issuance and role assumptions, and a data-minimization agreement. Also mark prompt persistence as opt-in, not default.

Sam: Implementation notes: we can deploy a Private sandbox into their VPC via peering (or VPC/VPN depending on their reqs). Logs from the env will be forwarded to their HEC over TLS. If they require the logs be encrypted by their CMK before leaving the account, they must create a Grant for our shipper role. We'll need the ARN and an IAM role we can assume.

Priya: Commercial: they're asking for pricing for a 30-day Dedicated pool (approx 2x A100 perf). Do we have a standard POC SKU / discount to propose? Need a line item to attach to the SOW.

Sam: Standard POC approach: offer a time-limited Dedicated reservation with 35% off list for 30 days, or a Private trial with infra hours billed at a discounted rate. I'll prep numbers but need RevOps to OK the discount.

Rohit: Evidence they'll need during/after POC: a) log schema with fields and redaction flags, b) sample of sanitized logs (no PII/PHI), c) KMS policy doc or signed BYOK addendum, d) network diagram showing peering and NAT behavior, e) mapping to SOC2 controls for logging/monitoring.

Priya: Customer also wants assurance they can export a full copy of logs to their SIEM at the end of the POC. Confirmed we can ship an S3 backup encrypted with their CMK (if granted) and continuous HEC forwarding.

Sam: Example trust snippet and HEC test we can give them (sanitized):

# Example minimal KMS grant (customer-managed)
# Note: replace ACCOUNT_ID and KEY_ID
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  LogShipperGrant:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Grant
    Properties:
      GranteePrincipal: arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD_LOG_ACCOUNT:role/log-shipper
      KeyId: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:ACCOUNT_ID:key/KEY_ID
      Operations: ["Encrypt", "Decrypt", "GenerateDataKey"]

# Splunk HEC test (sanitized)
curl -s -H 'Authorization: Splunk YOUR_HEC_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' https://splunk.medicore.com:8088/services/collector -d '{"event":"poc-log","env":"medicore-poc"}'

Rohit: Also request they provide an allowlist of outbound collector IPs for our egress NAT, or we can provide a static IP via NAT gateway. If they refuse NAT and require zero egress, we can deploy an on-prem forwarder in their network (extra ops effort).

ops-bot: Ticket POC-789 opened for Private deployment provisioning. Assigned: infra-poc. SLA: 72 hours for initial build, may extend if peering manual approval required.

LegalBot: BYOK requires signed addendum for key control and indemnities. Please attach completed security questionnaire before enabling BYOK.

Priya: Action items: 1) I'll request CMK ARN, Splunk HEC URL + token and an allowlist. 2) Sam/infra to confirm capacity and post SOW line item. 3) Rohit to draft required artifacts list for customer to provide.

Sam: I'll draft the infra checklist and include a config snippet for audit logging (API key issuance, role assume events) and retention 90 days.

Rohit: One more: redact full prompts by default for the POC unless customer explicitly signs to persist them. Mark as REQUIRED.

Priya: On it. I'll push the questionnaire and request the artifacts today. Will update thread when we have the CMK + HEC details. :white_check_mark:
